lines.en: I step outside to be greeted by warm air and a faint trace of reluctance.
lines.zh: 我走出门，迎接我的是温暖的空气和一丝淡淡的犹豫。

lines.en: I have a good idea of where Yumi is right now. And no, it’s not the bathroom like she said it would be. It’s somewhere I’ve found her before.
lines.zh: 我很清楚 Yumi 现在在哪儿。不，不是她说的洗手间。是我以前找到过她的地方。

lines.en: Somewhere she can gaze out at the water or the {b}stars{/b} or whatever it is she looks at when she’s alone to distract her from feeling anything.
lines.zh: 一个她可以凝望水面、或是{b}星空{/b}、或是她独处时用来转移注意力的任何东西的地方——好让自己什么都不去感受。

lines.en: But the reluctance comes into play not because I’m fearful of the mean words she’ll likely throw my way, but  because I’d hate to drag her into this again only for her to go right back to the start in a week or two.
lines.zh: 但这份犹豫并不是因为我害怕她大概会丢过来的刻薄话，而是因为我不愿意再把她拖进来，结果一两周后她又打回原形。

lines.en: It took her a little while to buy in last time, but she eventually did. And that made me feel like she was also buying into the idea that she was finally {i}a part{/i} of something.
lines.zh: 上次她过了好一阵才接受，但最终还是接受了。那让我觉得，她同时也接受了「自己终于成为某件事的{i}一部分{/i}」这个想法。

lines.en: Whether that’s actually true or not is another story entirely. But at the end of the day, she’s still someone important to me.
lines.zh: 那到底是不是真的，就是另一回事了。但说到底，她对我来说依然是重要的人。

lines.en: I mean...she may have even saved my life recently.
lines.zh: 我是说……她最近可能还救过我的命。

lines.en: But again, that’s another story entirely. And even though this one is technically {i}mine{/i} since I’m the one you’re looking at right now, there are plenty other characters. Plenty other people to root for.
lines.zh: 不过再说一次，那完全是另一回事。而且虽然这个故事严格来说是{i}我的{/i}——因为你现在看着的人是我——但还有很多别的人物。还有很多别的人值得你去支持。

lines.en: And that’s a good thing. Because I can’t imagine it’s easy rooting for me.
lines.zh: 而这是件好事。因为我想，支持我可不是什么轻松的事。

lines.en: I wonder if this is just how I’m going to be from now on? Tired. Despondent. Slowly giving up on the idea that my role here is even one of importance if the most important one of all was erased.
lines.zh: 我在想，我是不是从今往后就一直是这副样子了？疲惫。沮丧。慢慢放弃「我在这里的角色有什么重要性」这个念头——既然最重要的那一个已经被抹去了。

lines.en: I kind of hope Ayane’s right.
lines.zh: 我有点希望 Ayane 是对的。

lines.en: I kind of hope that someone takes my place...wakes me up when all of this is over...sifts through the shit and the mud and the passage of time and tells me when it’s okay to come out of hiding.
lines.zh: 我有点希望有人能取代我……等这一切结束的时候叫醒我……在屎、泥和时间的流逝里翻找，然后告诉我什么时候可以走出藏身之处。

lines.en: Because the god I don’t but maybe {i}do{/i} believe in knows that I’m not cut out for this.
lines.zh: 因为那个我不信、但也许{i}又信{/i}的神知道，我不是干这块的料。

lines.en: But even if that’s true (it is), I hope I can be forgiven for infecting someone else with the idea that things are greater than they appear to be sometimes.
lines.zh: 但即便如此（确实如此），我希望我能得到原谅——因为我把「有时候事情比表面看起来更宏大」这个念头传染给了别人。

lines.en: I just wonder why it always has to be in the dark.
lines.zh: 我只是想知道，为什么这种事总是要发生在黑暗里。
: Yumi。
我走向她。
她向后一缩。
我们四目相对。

lines.en: Hers are grey and mine are absent.
lines.zh: 她的眼睛是灰色的，而我的眼睛是空洞的。

lines.en: She gazes out at the night one more time.
lines.zh: 她又一次望向夜色。
她吸了一口气。

lines.en: And she paints my absence grey as the anti-sun dances around her.
lines.zh: 而她把我这份空洞也染成了灰色，反太阳在她周围起舞。

lines.en: : God damn it...really? Ain’t you got like four other girls to be perving out on right now? The fuck you come all the way out here for?
lines.zh: : 他妈的……真的假的？你不是还有四个女生可以让你在那儿发情吗？你大老远跑来这儿干吗？

lines.en: : Why do you think I came all the way out here?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我为什么大老远跑来这儿？

lines.en: : Becaaaaaause...you’re a creepy stalker who doesn’t know how to leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 因——为……你是个不知道怎么放过我的变态跟踪狂？

lines.en: : Well, I’ve definitely always been good at finding you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我确实一直很擅长找到你。

lines.en: : Exactly. Because you’re a creepy stalker who doesn’t know how to leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 就是啊。因为你是个不知道怎么放过我的变态跟踪狂。
: 是啊……我想是的。
: 呃……谢……谢你肯承认？

lines.en: : Why are you just looking at me like that?...
lines.zh: : 你干嘛就那么看着我？……

lines.en: : If I knew you were going to be here, I would have worn my jumpsuit. So if your goal is to just fuckin’ ogle at me or whatever before pouncing on me again, I’ll fuckin’ kill you, you-
lines.zh: : 早知道你会来，我就穿连体工装了。所以你要是就打算在扑上来之前盯着我看个够什么的，我他妈杀了你，你——

lines.en: : Yumi, I need to talk to you about something.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我有件事得跟你谈。
: 为什么是我？……

lines.en: : Because that’s what’s worked in the past. And if either one of us is ever going to get out of this place, we’re going to have to help each other.
lines.zh: : 因为以前就是这么奏效的。而且如果我们俩有谁想离开这个地方，就得互相帮忙。

lines.en: : Help each other...how? What are you asking?
lines.zh: : 互相帮忙……怎么帮？你想让我做什么？

lines.en: : Just to listen...as closely as you can.
lines.zh: : 只是听……尽可能仔细地听。
: 要是我听不进去呢？
: 我就吻你。
: 呕。坚决拒绝。

lines.en: : See? I knew that would be all the motivation you’d need. So if you don’t want that to happen, pay attention.
lines.zh: : 你看？我就知道那就是你需要的全部动力。所以你要是不想那样，就认真听。
: 这个世界——

lines.en: : Wait. Hold on. And...no kissing since...you technically haven’t started yet.
lines.zh: : 等等。等一下。还有……不许吻我，因为……严格来说你还没开始呢。

lines.en: : How do I even fuckin’ put this?
lines.zh: : 我他妈该怎么说啊？
: Sensei，我……

lines.en: : I think I know what this is about.
lines.zh: : 我想我知道这是关于什么的。
: 我对此深表怀疑，Yumi。
: 不，就是……
: 我们不是已经……{i}做过{/i}这个了吗？……

lines.en: : This creepy...slumber party shit. And you...comin’ out here to talk to me when I want to be alone, which...I mean, I guess that’s happened a million times by now. But like...here {i}specifically.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这种诡异的……睡衣派对破事。还有你……在我想要独处的时候跑出来找我说话，这……我是说，大概已经发生过一百万次了。但{i}就是{/i}……在这个地方。

lines.en: : I...you know, maybe that {i}ain’t{/i} why you’re out here and shit but, like...
lines.zh: : 我……你知道，也许你跑出来{i}不{/i}是为了这个，但是……

lines.en: : Weird shit follows you pretty much everywhere you go and-
lines.zh: : 你走到哪儿，诡异的破事就跟到哪儿，而且——

lines.en: : No, you’re right. That’s why I’m here.
lines.zh: : 不，你说得对。我就是为了这个来的。

lines.en: : So we, like...{i}have{/i} had this conversation before?
lines.zh: : 所以我们……以前{i}真的{/i}聊过这个？

lines.en: : Not...specifically. It’s complicated. But we {i}have{/i} done something {i}like{/i} this before. You didn’t remember it, though...So why do you suddenly remember it {i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : 不完全是。说来复杂。但我们以前{i}确实{/i}做过{i}类似{/i}的事。只不过你不记得了……那你为什么{i}现在{/i}突然想起来了？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. I’ve been havin’ tons of shit like that happen to me lately. Things that feel like dreams but...seem more like memories. It’s like fuckin’ deja vu on steroids. Ain’t none of it’s good either.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。最近这种事在我身上发生了一堆。感觉像梦，但……更像记忆。简直像打了鸡血的既视感。而且没一件是好事。

lines.en: : What do you mean by “not good?” Do you remember the reset as well?
lines.zh: : 「不是好事」是什么意思？你也记得重置的事？
: 重置是什么鬼？

lines.en: : Okay. Well, I guess that answers that question.
lines.zh: : 好吧。看来这就回答了那个问题。

lines.en: : I just meant, like...shit that feels wrong. Or shit that never even happened but...{i}feels{/i} like it happened.
lines.zh: : 我只是说……感觉不对劲的事。或者压根没发生过、但{i}感觉{/i}就像发生过的事。
: 我……不太明白。

lines.en: : Then...example. You ain’t ever given me detention...right?
lines.zh: : 那……举个例子。你从没让我留过校……对吧？
: 没有。太麻烦了。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly. Then why the fuck do I have so many memories of you doin’ that? And why the fuck are they all so goddamn illegal and rapey and shit?
lines.zh: : 对啊，就是啊。那为什么我脑子里有一大堆你让我留校的记忆？而且为什么那些记忆全他妈违法又强暴什么的？

lines.en: : These just sound like fantasies to me.
lines.zh: : 在我听来这些就是幻想。

lines.en: : They ain’t fantasies, ass-wipe! This might come as a surprise to you, but not everybody’s interested in getting dicked down by your friggin’ micropenis! That shit {i}happened!{/i}
lines.zh: : 那才不是幻想，你这擦屁股的！你可能不知道，但不是谁都想被你那根迷你小屌操！那事是{i}发生过{/i}的！

lines.en: : And between all these weird fuckin’ blackouts and coincidences, I know that {i}you{/i} know somethin’! So whatever the fuck it is, tell me! The hell’s goin’ on with my head?!
lines.zh: : 再加上这些诡异的断片和各种巧合，我知道{i}你{/i}肯定知道些什么！所以不管那是什么，告诉我！我脑子里到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: : I think the same thing that’s going on with Nodoka’s right now.
lines.zh: : 我想，跟 Nodoka 现在的情况是一样的。

lines.en: : You’ve got some serious balls bringin’ that piece of shit up around me, but aight. Let’s hear it. The fuck’s goin’ on with {i}her?{/i} How’s it like what’s happenin’ to me?
lines.zh: : 你胆子真够大的，敢在我面前提那个垃圾。不过行吧。说说看。{i}她{/i}怎么了？跟我的情况怎么像了？

lines.en: : Since I apparently don’t have to be careful with what I say around you anymore, let’s just go ahead and {i}call{/i} them memories. That’s probably stuff that happened in other timelines.
lines.zh: : 既然我在你面前说话显然不用再小心翼翼了，那我们就直接把它们{i}叫作{/i}记忆吧。那大概是在其他时间线里发生过的事。
: 时间线？……

lines.en: : You mean you and me are just goin’ around havin’ fuckin’ slumber parties in multiple timelines? And I’m supposed to believe that?
lines.zh: : 你是说你和我一直在不同的时间线里开他妈的睡衣派对？你要我相信这个？

lines.en: : Actually, the other slumber party was {i}this{/i} timeline. Just a different section of it.
lines.zh: : 其实，上一次睡衣派对就是{i}这条{/i}时间线。只是它不同的区段。

lines.en: : Every few months, we get sent back to an earlier part of the school year. And, with the exception of three of us, no one retains any memories of it. You are one of those people.
lines.zh: : 每隔几个月，我们就会被送回学年的更早阶段。而除了我们三个之外，没有人保留任何记忆。你就是其中之一。

lines.en: : But this isn’t the first time you’ve caught on. It’s happened before. Which is why we’re dragging you into it again now.
lines.zh: : 但这不是你第一次察觉了。以前发生过。所以现在我们才又把你拖进来。

lines.en: : You’re clearly special in some way, Yumi. I just don’t get {i}how.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你显然在某种意义上是特别的，Yumi。我只是不明白是{i}哪种{/i}。

lines.en: : Because I’m suddenly rememberin’ all this weird shit that never happened but maybe {i}did{/i} happen in another universe?
lines.zh: : 就因为我突然记起了这些从没发生过、但也许在另一个宇宙里{i}确确实实{/i}发生过的怪事？
: 差不多。
: 可是如果……

lines.en: : If I’m just gonna go back to {i}not{/i} knowin’ any of this shit soon, the fuck am I supposed to do about it? You gonna just...keep remindin’ me every single time?
lines.zh: : 如果我很快又要变回什么都不知道的状态，那我他妈能怎么办？你就打算……每次都来提醒我？

lines.en: : I’m going to try. But there’s no guarantee I’ll be the same person either since there {i}were{/i} four of us but...there aren’t anymore.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力。但我也没法保证自己还是同一个人，毕竟我们{i}本来{/i}是四个……可现在不是了。

lines.en: : What do you mean you won’t be the same person?
lines.zh: : 什么叫你不会是同一个人？

lines.en: : I mean I could go back to the type of teacher who gives you detention.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我可能会变回那种会让你留校的老师。
: 不……你在耍我。

lines.en: : If I am, it’s unintentional. Hell, maybe I even did that shit to you in {i}this{/i} universe but have no recollection of it because my mind’s gotten all tangled up in the threads of time.
lines.zh: : 如果我在耍你，那也是无意的。妈的，也许我在{i}这个{/i}宇宙里真对你干过那种事，只是因为脑子被时间线缠成一团所以记不起来了。

lines.en: : But the fact is that the {i}current{/i} me, the one that you’ve now experienced five separate freshman beach trips with, might not be the one you have in a few months.
lines.zh: : 但事实是，{i}现在{/i}的我——那个你已经和ta一起经历过五次不同的一年级海滩旅行的我——可能不是几个月后你面对的那个人。

lines.en: : Accepting that is just part of living with the burden of truth at this point. And even though you’ll probably forget it when you’re reset again, you know now.
lines.zh: : 到了这一步，接受这一点只是背负真相生活的一部分。虽然你下次被重置时大概会忘记，但你现在知道了。

lines.en: : So if you {i}do{/i} carry over and {i}I{/i} don’t, don’t think of that new person as me. I only exist here and now — the same as you.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你带走了记忆而{i}我{/i}没有，别把那个新的人当成我。我只存在于此时此地——跟你一样。

lines.en: : And I’m glad that’s the case because I can’t bear the thought of you being like this with anyone other than me.
lines.zh: : 而我很庆幸是这样，因为我无法忍受你跟别人也这样。

lines.en: : What is that supposed to mean?...
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？……

lines.en: : The same thing you meant when you said I was fucking with you, just in a slightly more obvious way.
lines.zh: : 跟你说的「我在耍你」是一个意思，只是稍微明显一点。
: Sensei，我——

lines.en: : Jesus, fuck. Shit came outta nowhere.
lines.zh: : 天啊，操。这雨来得莫名其妙。

lines.en: : It ain’t even supposed to rain to-
lines.zh: : 今天明明说不会下——

lines.en: : The fuck do you think you’re doing?...
lines.zh: : 你他妈以为你在干什么？……

lines.en: : That was the part where you were supposed to get scared and grab me for comfort. You missed your cue.
lines.zh: : 那是你本该被吓到、然后抓着我寻求安慰的部分。你错过提示了。
: 错过了我的……
: 走吧……

lines.en: : Let’s get out of the rain.
lines.zh: : 我们避避雨。

lines.en: We find shelter beneath a small wooden structure the staff here must use for storage. I don’t know. I’m thinking of other things at the moment.
lines.zh: 我们在一栋小木棚下找到避雨处，那大概是这里的工作人员用来储物的。我不知道。我此刻在想别的事。

lines.en: Namely the fact that I’m stuck here with Yumi — a girl who, by all accounts, is meant to despise and abhor me no matter {i}what{/i} timeline we find ourselves stuck in.
lines.zh: 具体来说，就是我和 Yumi 被困在这儿——一个按理说无论我们陷在{i}哪条{/i}时间线里都注定要厌恶我、憎恨我的女孩。

lines.en: Yet the only dry spot on my body is a space on my palm that she didn’t release until just a few seconds ago.
lines.zh: 然而我身上唯一干的地方，是掌心的一小块——直到几秒前她才松开。

lines.en: Her hand was smaller than I expected. But that’s probably just because I’ve never seen her as dainty or fragile even during moments like this where she unintentionally reminds me she’s just another teenage girl.
lines.zh: 她的手比我预想的小。但那大概只是因为我从来没把她看成纤细或脆弱的人，即便在这种她无意间提醒我「她也只是个十几岁的女孩」的时刻。

lines.en: Neither one of us speaks for a staggering amount of time. We just look out at the ocean as it attempts to drown itself and silently contemplate just how long we’re willing to wait here for.
lines.zh: 我们有长得吓人的一段时间谁都没说话。我们只是望着大海试图把自己淹死，同时默默盘算，我们愿意在这里等多久。
永远也行。

lines.en: Maybe we’ll get lucky and the world will end here so I can experience one last moment with her before everything starts over again.
lines.zh: 也许我们会走运，世界就在这儿终结，好让我在一切重新开始之前，再和她共度最后一个瞬间。

lines.en: Before I have to seek her out and do this same song and dance. Wait for the past to sink in like my knife in the back of Maya as I manage to forgo the thought of it being {i}her{/i} hand that kept me dry this time.
lines.zh: 在我不得不再次去找她、重复这套老把戏之前。等过去像我插进 Maya 背后的刀一样深深陷进去——同时努力不去想，这一次是{i}她{/i}的手让我保持了干爽。

lines.en: But what does the present mean for the future? And how will finding out that Yumi {i}is{/i} special play into Ayane’s plan for saving the world and marrying me?
lines.zh: 但当下对未来意味着什么？而发现 Yumi {i}确实{/i}特别，会如何影响 Ayane 那套「拯救世界并嫁给我」的计划？

lines.en: Because one time wouldn’t mean much. Two times means something. But what if it’s three or four or five or more and all of them have gone unnoticed because of what we are to one another?
lines.zh: 因为一次说明不了什么。两次才说明问题。可如果是三次、四次、五次甚至更多，却都因为我们彼此的关系而被忽略了呢？

lines.en: I don’t know {i}what{/i} to think anymore now that the threads are beginning to untangle. But while they loosen their hold on me, they tie harder around someone else.
lines.zh: 如今丝线开始解开，我不知道该想{i}什么{/i}了。但它们在我身上松开的同时，却在别人身上缠得更紧。

lines.en: And if I were Yumi right now, I’d be scared. I know that for sure because I {i}was{/i} Yumi once — back when none of this made sense and I struggled to fit my fingers through the noose around my neck.
lines.zh: 如果我现在是 Yumi，我会害怕。这一点我敢肯定，因为我曾经{i}就是{/i} Yumi——在那一切都讲不通、我挣扎着把手指塞进脖子上那根绞索的年代。

lines.en: But will she let me untie the one around hers? Or will she keep forcing herself to keep me at bay because this whole fucking {i}world{/i} is scary even {i}without{/i} all of the time shit?
lines.zh: 可她会让我解开她脖子上那根吗？还是说她会继续强撑着把我拒之门外——因为哪怕{i}没有{/i}那些时间破事，这整个操蛋的{i}世界{/i}本身就够吓人的？

lines.en: : Would’ve worn my fuckin’ swimsuit if I knew this shit was gonna happen. I’m friggin’ soaked now.
lines.zh: : 早知道会这样我就穿那该死的泳衣了。我现在湿透了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be opposed to that. In fact, I’ll even volunteer to run back to the room and grab it for you.
lines.zh: : 我可不反对。事实上，我甚至可以自告奋勇跑回房间替你拿。

lines.en: : Yeah, of course you would. Maybe ditch the sweatpants while you’re at it and grab your own too. You ain’t a pretty sight right now. Even worse than normal actually.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你当然会。顺便把你那条运动裤也换了吧，顺便把自己的也拿来。你现在可不太好看。实际上比平时还糟。

lines.en: : Harsh. And to think I gave you my first kiss...
lines.zh: : 真刻薄。想想看，我把初吻给了你呢……
: {i}放屁。{/i}而你{i}偷走{/i}了我的。
: 我一点都不后悔。
: 开玩笑的。我什么都后悔。

lines.en: : Only thing I regret is not flippin’ you over that fuckin’ ledge.
lines.zh: : 我唯一后悔的，是没把你从那个该死的悬崖边掀下去。

lines.en: : You mean the one you recently saved me from flipping myself over? Do you regret that too?
lines.zh: : 你是说你前不久阻止我自己翻下去的那个？那个你也后悔？

lines.en: : Depends on how much you can teach me about whatever’s goin’ on with my brain and shit. Which probably ain’t much based on your track record, but we’ll see.
lines.zh: : 那得看你能教我多少关于我脑子里这些事的东西。照你以往的战绩大概教不了多少，不过走着瞧吧。

lines.en: : It’s not your mind, Yumi. It’s the world itself. I already told you that.
lines.zh: : 那不是你的脑子，Yumi。是世界本身。我已经跟你说过了。

lines.en: : World...brain...whatever. Shit’s fucked either way. Just make sure there’s pizza at the next slumber party.
lines.zh: : 世界……脑子……随便吧。反正都是一团糟。下次睡衣派对记得准备披萨。

lines.en: I take a seat on the floor and watch as Yumi wrings her ponytail out like a washcloth.
lines.zh: 我在地板上坐下，看着 Yumi 把马尾像拧抹布一样拧干。

lines.en: Her pajama top sticks to her skin, dripping water onto her thighs that rolls down them only to be soaked up by her socks.
lines.zh: 她的睡衣上衣贴在皮肤上，水珠滴到大腿上，顺着往下滚，最后被袜子吸干。

lines.en: But we’re alone in here — there’s no hidden narrator or disembodied voice this time — so I resist the urge to tell her it’d be better if we both strip {i}regardless{/i} of how much I want to.
lines.zh: 但我们现在独处——这次没有隐藏的旁白，也没有无实体的声音——所以我忍住了没说「不如我们俩都脱光」，{i}尽管{/i}我有多想那么说。

lines.en: Of course I still stare at her, though. I’m only human.
lines.zh: 当然我还是在盯着她看。我只是个凡人。
: 看得开心吗？
: 比你想象的开心。
: 变态……
: 正是在下。

lines.en: : So, what were you about to say before we were so rudely interrupted by nature?
lines.zh: : 那么，在我们被大自然这么粗暴地打断之前，你本来想说什么？

lines.en: : That you should fuck off forever. And that I don’t care if you’re replaced by some {i}other{/i} you since they all equally suck.
lines.zh: : 说你该永远滚蛋。还有，我不在乎你会不会被{i}别的{/i}你取代，反正都一样烂。

lines.en: : Ahh, so nature was just trying to save me from being insulted again.
lines.zh: : 啊，所以大自然只是想救我，免得我再被骂。

lines.en: : Would that really be a huge surprise at this point? What with you apparently bein’ a time traveler or whatever the fuck you’re supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 到了这地步，这还有什么好惊讶的？你显然是个时间旅行者，或者随便什么鬼东西。

lines.en: : Just a really unlucky guy, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，只是个特别倒霉的家伙。

lines.en: : I’ll say. All the time in the world and you’re still stuck stalkin’ {i}me{/i} every fuckin’ day of your life. What a waste.
lines.zh: : 说得对。全世界的时间都给你了，你还困在每天跟踪{i}我{/i}这件事上。真是浪费。

lines.en: : I’d have it no other way.
lines.zh: : 我别无他求。

lines.en: : Well, you should. Cause all you’re doin’ by even talkin’ to me about this ain’t gonna help at all. The fuck am {i}I{/i} gonna do about it? I ain’t cut out for time travel. I barely know long division.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你该有别的追求。因为你跟{i}我{/i}说这些根本没用。我又能怎么办？我可不是干时间旅行这块的料。我连长除法都勉强。

lines.en: : I could teach you. I’ve got all the “long division” you’ll ever need right here.
lines.zh: : 我可以教你。你要的「长除法」我这儿应有尽有。
: 什么？
: 我指的是我的——

lines.en: : Oh! Ew! What the fuck, man?!
lines.zh: : 哦！呕！你他妈有病吧？！

lines.en: : Damn. I thought I might actually get a laugh out of that one.
lines.zh: : 靠。我还以为这次真能逗笑你。

lines.en: : That would require being funny — a thing you definitely are not. So please keep your creepy fuckin’ comments to yourself until the rain stops. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 那得要求你幽默——而你显然一点都不。所以在雨停之前，请你把那些变态的该死的评论留给自己。谢谢。

lines.en: : So I can start again once the storm is over? Got it. I’ll just keep staring at you until then.
lines.zh: : 所以暴风雨停了我就能重新开始？明白了。在那之前我就一直盯着你看。

lines.en: : Don’t do that either...that’s even worse.
lines.zh: : 那个也别做……那更糟。
: 为什么？你很美。
: 滚蛋，喂……

lines.en: : Do you not like being called that?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢被这么叫吗？

lines.en: : I don’t like bein’ messed with...
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢被人耍……

lines.en: : I’m not, though. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 可我没有。我是认真的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’d mean that for literally anyone in high school. I could just be a pair of boobs with legs and you’d still be all over me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你对高中里任何人都会这么说。我哪怕就是一对长了腿的胸，你照样会扑上来。

lines.en: : If they’re the same ones you have now, probably. They’re extremely impressive.
lines.zh: : 如果和你现在这对一样，大概会。它们实在令人印象深刻。

lines.en: : Fuckin’ quit it, dude! You’re seriously creepin’ me out!
lines.zh: : 他妈的别说了，混蛋！你真的让我毛骨悚然！

lines.en: : I’m on Noriko’s side. You really should stop wrapping yourself up. For my personal benefit, of course.
lines.zh: : 我站 Noriko 那边。你真该别再把自己裹起来了。当然，是为了我个人好。
: 你这该死的——

lines.en: : Know what?! How ‘bout I just gouge your eyes out! That way-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？！不如我直接把你的眼睛挖出来！那样——
: 呀啊！操！

lines.en: : I fucking hate thunder! Why’s it always gotta happen at the worst possible time?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈最讨厌打雷了！为什么总是在最糟糕的时候来？！
: 还有你——

lines.en: I can hear two things — a storm and the sound of her breathing.
lines.zh: 我能听见两样东西——暴风雨，和她的呼吸声。

lines.en: But I can only see one.
lines.zh: 但我只看得见一样。
其余的一切都被涂成了灰色。
: 我们……
: 不该……
: 我好像……听到了什么……
: 不该{i}什么{/i}？
: 我们只是……
: 不该……
: 不该{i}什么{/i}？……
: 说出来，Yumi……
: 我说不出口……
: 做过一次……已经……

lines.en: : L...Let’s just go back to your room! The rain ain’t as...bad as it was before. We’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 我……我们还是回你房间吧！雨没有刚才……那么大了。我们会没事的。

lines.en: : {i}But we should take the back entrance so no one sees me. Doing this was the whole reason I came in the first place.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我们得走后门，别让人看见我。做这件事才是我来的全部理由。{/i}
: {i}行吧，随便。就……他妈的走吧。{/i}
: {i}Yumi？……{/i}
: 是他妈的 Yumi？！？！？！
: 哈哈……哈哈哈哈哈！哈哈哈！
: 哈哈……
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: What did {i}you{/i} hear in the rain?
lines.zh: {i}你{/i}在雨里听见了什么？
